intro.caption: Midnight. Commit City.
intro.line: Every lit window out there is a commit I made. Some of them even worked.

intro.caption: Then the phone rings.
intro.caller: I hear you build things. Show me. Then we talk about a job.

intro.caption: One auto. Five stops. The meter is running.
intro.line: Fine. Get in. I'll show you what I've built, and what I broke.

mapIdle: Pick a marker and the auto will take us there.
mapAfterThree: That caller again. You can pick the call up on the phone whenever you like.

ending.reveal: Hold on. That number. It's yours.
ending.caption: The unknown caller was you, all along.
ending.line: You asked me to show you what I've built. So: do we have a job?

acceptedLine: Great. Here's how to reach me.

subtitles.line: Tallest building in town. 280 commits of data structures, one floor at a time.
Only one way to see the rest of this city.
Every big build starts like this: a leap, and no idea where the floor is.
Those signs? That's everything I've picked up on the way down.
And this is what I've shipped. Keep up.
Nice city. I hear you can build things. Got a job for you.
